driver_design_review: GO: one full-grid forward diagnostic connects directly to the current z=0 inference; no further toy contraction campaign or external audit when Astra drives.
goal: Determine whether low-order LOS integration error matters for the current CF4-associated z=0 development inference before investing in dynamic Q1 differentiation. Preserve the goal of extending empirically constrained k and <=0.3 cMpc/h numerical zoom ICs.

inputs.selection: Only raw_selection_exposure from the declared Phase_A_datum; no observed count member read

method.state: Plug-in posterior field means, nuisance prior medians, zero selection calibration; these are not complete posterior draws or posterior predictive means.
method.current_rule: Use the actual program offsets/weights (GH2), not the historical GH3 assumption.
method.reference: Gauss-Legendre integration on [-8,8] with normalized Gaussian weights at 128 and 256 points; numerical reference only after convergence and sourcewise sealed Q1 comparison.
method.q1_probe_indices: 8 evenly spaced flat source indices fixed before evaluation, all six populations at both FoG settings
method.geometry: Keep the current pre-coherent-RSD LOS fixed for both rules. This isolates broadening integration; the Q1 selected-intensity post-RSD LOS convention is a separate model choice.
method.grid: Full current N32, L384, 32768 Eulerian sources; not N192 PM particles.
statistics: expected conditional-Poisson log-likelihood loss KL(reference || current)
k-shell selected-intensity power ratio and residual power versus expected Poisson shot noise
method.reference_gate: 128-to-256 full-field relative L1 <=1e-5; 256-to-Q1 per-source relative L1 <=1e-5; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE and no necessity decision.
method.decision: Potentially material at the tested state if total Poisson KL >=1 nat. Smaller is BELOW_ONE_NAT_AT_TESTED_STATES_ONLY, never a global operator or posterior approval. Require reference self-KL <=0.01 nat and <=1 percent of legacy-to-reference KL when legacy KL >=1.
method.frontier: Report the entire mesh Fourier range. No observational information frontier is assumed or inferred from two plug-in means.

deferred: new sampling or PM truth generation
boundary: Driver evaluates the completed bundle and waits for user approval before the next bundle.
